Done! Created `renderInvoiceText(invoice)` in src/render.js with 10 comprehensive tests. All 62 tests pass ✓

Changes:
- Updated `createInvoice`, `addLine`, `removeLine`, and `issueInvoice` to include and preserve `customerName` (looked up at creation)
- `renderInvoiceText` formats invoices as readable plain text: invoice number/DRAFT header, customer name, line items with qty × product @ unitPrice = lineTotal, and total line
- All customer-facing amounts use `formatEuros()` for proper currency formatting

Sample output:
```
INV-2026-0001
Northwind Studio
  5 × Development (hour) @ €95.00 = €475.00
  100 × Sticker sheet @ €0.50 = €50.00
Total: €525.00
```
